results.title: StreamFlix announces Premium tier repricing for Fall 2026
results.snippet: StreamFlix will raise Premium from $15.99 to $29.99 in September 2026 for new and renewing subscribers. Existing annual plans keep grandfathered pricing until renewal.

results.title: Cord-cutter forums react to StreamFlix Premium hike
results.snippet: Users report autopay drafts at $29.99 without clear in-app notice. Recommended action: confirm plan tier and cancel/downgrade before next draft.

results.title: PG&E billing FAQ — duplicate statements
results.snippet: Customers sometimes receive a paper notice and an e-bill for the same period. Pay once; contact support if two drafts appear on the same account.

results.title: Dental crown typical patient responsibility after PPO
results.snippet: After PPO remittance, patient responsibility for a single crown commonly lands between $200–$500. Confirm EOB before paying the full office estimate.

results.snippet: Online renewal available if no holds. Keep proof of insurance and smog certificate if required for the vehicle class.
